name: coven_tiny_1.1b_32k_orpo_alpha
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0 (config.json max_position_embeddings 2048). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-04. A finetune of TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.1 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2024-04-23.
